Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 14-G at 1058 W 59th St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                         ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe B3-1,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 14-G in the
area bound by:

       the alley next north of and parallel to West 59"^ Street; a line 82.7 feet next east of and
       parallel to South Aberdeen Street; West 59"^ Street;.and South Aberdeen Street

to those of a C1-1, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                                          Di Coleman
                                                                        , 16" Ward




Common Address:
1058 W. 59th Street
